# Copilot Instructions

- **App scope**: Static prototype (no bundler/tests); plain HTML + Bootstrap 5 from CDN in [index.html](../index.html), JS in [assets/js/app.js](../assets/js/app.js), styles in [assets/css/app.css](../assets/css/app.css). Keep assets path-safe for GitHub Pages style hosting (relative URLs).
- **Data model**: All content comes from [assets/data/workshops.db](../assets/data/workshops.db). Keys: `workshops`, `offerings`, `series`, `instructors`, `departments`, `formats`, `areas`, `audiences`. Relationships are by ID arrays (e.g., `workshop.area_ids`, `audience_ids`, `department_ids`, `instructor_ids`; offerings point to `workshop_id`). `is_active` must be true to render.
- **Layout**: Left sidebar filters (col-lg-3/col-md-4) with resizable drag handle, main content area (col-lg-9/col-md-8). Sidebar is sticky with `max-height: 100vh` and overflow-y auto. On mobile (<768px), sidebar is fixed off-canvas with hamburger toggle button and overlay backdrop. Resize handle is 8px wide on right edge; drag adjusts width between 200-600px (hidden on mobile).
- **Timeframe filtering**: Toggle buttons in sidebar header switch between "Upcoming" (default) and "Past" workshops. Filter compares offering start dates against `this.now`. Workshops with no offerings are hidden. Timeframe is tracked in `this.filters.timeframe` and URL params. Past offerings show dates/location but hide registration/calendar buttons.
- **UI wiring**: Filters and search read/write `this.filters` (search is lowercased, timeframe defaults to 'upcoming') and update the URL query via `updateURL()` in [assets/js/app.js](../assets/js/app.js). Adding a new filter requires: input element with `*Filter` id, add id to `setupEventListeners` select list, populate options in `populateFilters`, extend `clearFilters`, `filterAndDisplayWorkshops`, `updateActiveFiltersDisplay`, and `getFilterSummary`. Timeframe toggle buttons use `setTimeframe()` method to update state and button styling.
- **Rendering**: Workshop cards are built in `createWorkshopCard` (grid view) or `createWorkshopListItem` (list view) using related lookup tables for labels/icons. Offerings per workshop are injected by `createOfferingsSection`, which filters by timeframe and conditionally shows registration/calendar buttons only for upcoming sessions. Descriptions are truncated to 150/400 chars (grid/list) with `[+]` toggles; preserve `data-full`/`data-truncated` attributes when changing markup.
- **Sorting**: Default sort is upcoming date; uses the first offering per workshop. Missing offerings are pushed after dated ones. Alternate sort is title.
- **Calendar actions (browser)**: `createAddToCalendarButton` builds dropdowns via [assets/js/add-to-calendar.js](../assets/js/add-to-calendar.js); Apple link triggers ICS download with two reminder alarms. `subscribeToCalendar` currently shows a Bootstrap modal with manual import instructions, then calls `downloadICS()` which uses `ICalGenerator.generate`.
- **Calendar generation (static files)**: Node script [scripts/generate-ics.js](../scripts/generate-ics.js) mirrors the browser `ICalGenerator` and writes prefiltered `.ics` files under [calendars/](../calendars). Run locally with `node scripts/generate-ics.js` after editing `workshops.json`. Filenames follow `all.ics`, `area-<id>.ics`, `audience-<id>.ics`, `format-<id>.ics`, `department-<id>.ics`, plus combo examples `online-grad.ics`, `in-person-grad.ics`.
- **Date/times**: Offerings expect ISO 8601 with timezone offsets; ICS formatting in both generators is local time (no `Z`). Duration and reminders are derived from `start`/`end`; keep `end` populated.
- **Content updates**: To add a workshop, define instructors/departments/formats/areas/audiences first (or reuse existing IDs) in `*` collections, then add workshop entry with `is_active` and matching `offering_ids`, and add offerings with `workshop_id`. Missing lookups will render as blank labels.
- **Styling**: Custom design lives in [assets/css/app.css](../assets/css/app.css); [assets/css/app.scss](../assets/css/app.scss) is empty. Primary palette and gradient header are defined via CSS variables; Google Font Nunito Sans is imported there. Keep class names `workshop-card`, `filter-pill`, `sidebar-resize-handle`, etc., stable for JS/CSS hooks. Sidebar has `.sidebar-resize-handle` for drag-to-resize with hover states (opacity 0.3 on hover, 0.5 when dragging). `body.resizing-sidebar` prevents text selection during drag.
- **Sidebar resize**: Implemented in `initSidebarResize()` method with mousedown/mousemove/mouseup handlers. Drag handle is absolute positioned on sidebar's right edge. Min-width 200px, max-width 600px enforced during drag. Handle hidden on mobile via `@media (max-width: 767px)`. Flex basis set to 'none' when custom width applied.
- **Dependencies**: External only via CDNs (Bootstrap 5.3.8, Bootstrap Icons). No npm install needed unless running the Node generator (uses built-in `fs`, `path`).
- **Hosting expectations**: `fetch('assets/data/workshops.json')` assumes same-origin; ensure the JSON is deployed alongside HTML. `subscribeToCalendar` builds URLs assuming `calendars/` sits next to `index.html`.

Please suggest edits or missing details you want captured.
